title: Grievance
meta_description: It is a committee to present grievances of all sorts for students, staff and parents.
paragraphs: The Grievance Redressal Committee is established to address and resolve complaints and concerns raised by students, faculty, and staff in a fair, transparent, and timely manner.This committee is mandatory under guidelines from bodies like UGC, AICTE, and NAAC, and must exist in all higher educational institutions. Objectives of the Grievance Redressal Committee:1. To provide a platform for stakeholders (students, faculty, staff) to raise grievances related to academic, administrative, or personal matters.2. To investigate complaints impartially and confidentially.3. To resolve grievances in a time-bound manner.4. To promote a positive and supportive institutional climate. Common Grievances Handled:• Harassment (including bullying or ragging)• Unfair academic evaluation or discrimination• Delay in scholarship disbursement• Issues related to examination or attendance• Infrastructure problems• Administrative inefficiencies
